evidence.source: Development fast-lane rollout on 16ce4d5; contracts 114 and 115 applied 5 August 2026 in one run, the first time two were outstanding at once. The lane derived the pending set and proved each migration additive by reading it before applying. Corroborated read-only afterwards: the ledger holds 115 rows through 20260805110000. CONTRACT 115 — pg_net is installed at 0.20.4, having reported installed_version null before this rollout, which is the whole gap the contract closes. All five new objects are deployed BYTE-IDENTICAL to the committed migration: due_provider_poll_targets md5 f4d9afded794eca2124607204d9df95b over 581 characters, provider_poll_endpoint 3ee71c07e55bfd57a11c5f460a2d4968 over 814, post_provider_poll c9c00d1460a8eab3ff170d77f0f30de8 over 576, dispatch_due_provider_polls 5b0443e91fe3c5444f817650e8267cff over 2278 and touch_provider_poll_target dbd8a5d98dcc1982bcbb63ec828f0867 over 64. Each is security definer with search_path pinned to the empty string and granted to no browser or service role. Both new tables have row level security enabled and zero grants to anon, authenticated or service_role. The pg_cron entry provider-poll-dispatch-due-targets exists at */5 * * * * and is active. It is behaviour-neutral: zero poll targets and zero dispatches, so the job runs and does nothing. THE RESIDUAL IS RECORDED RATHER THAN GLOSSED — anon, authenticated and service_role all retain usage on the net schema after the apply, exactly as the migration predicted and reported by notice: postgres is neither superuser nor a member of supabase_admin, so Supabase's platform grants on pg_net survive. The boundary the contract does enforce is verified: ZERO browser-reachable functions in public or graphql_public reference net. CONTRACT 114 — all four season card RPCs are deployed and granted to authenticated: get_season_matchweek_card (md5 1110a2e9), save_season_prediction (2bca0ab6), set_season_matchweek_joker (6859c34b) and confirm_season_matchweek_card (8e96eda6). CALLER KEY NOW RESOLVES, established by the same probe that found it broken. Two probes through net.http_post with a deliberately wrong apikey returned HTTP 500 function_not_configured, detail 'Missing named Supabase secret key: provider-poll' — a name that cannot exist, because Supabase rejects a hyphen in a secret key name. CALLER_KEY_NAME is now provider_poll, the Edge Function was redeployed from the committed sources as version 3 (ACTIVE, verify_jwt false, ezbr_sha256 2b45e9698f63985ff6ee75da6e20c2c98fbb4bb157688254939df638fe24a81c), and the identical probe returned 401 unauthorized. No provider was contacted by any of the three probes and no provider credential was spent — the function answers on its own configuration and its caller's key before it reads the request. The three provider API keys therefore remain unproven, as does any archive path. The 578 league fixtures present in both seasons remain the invented development seed, not real football.
